about: Hand-made decisions about organisation names that the automatic match (admin/build/lib/derive.mjs) cannot make: same_as links a name as listed to one of our companies, with the reason; not_same records a near miss that was looked at and is not the company. Every entry names who decided and why. When unsure, leave it out: an unlinked name is honest, a wrong link is not.

same_as.why: The company's own summit appearance page (its source s1) is the page of "Cisco Systems, Inc."; the same key covers "Cisco Systems" and "CIsco Systems" as speaker cards write it.
DG CONNECT is a directorate-general of the European Commission; the curator's capture already names the Commission as "European Commission (DG CONNECT, DG GROW)".

not_same.why: A Formula 1 team that carries the sponsor's name, not the software company.
